spots.bio: Stringybark woodland park with walking trails, 80-plus bird species and a former prison camp site.
spots.name: Kyeema Conservation Park
spots.note: NPWS SA visitor page (free entry, walking trails through regenerating stringybark woodland, 80+ bird species, former prison camp site) plus Fleurieu tourism listing in attractions and nature lists. A 347 ha park with walking trails is a half-hour-plus visit; modest second-tier stop. Objection: no single named walk or lookout, mostly bushwalkers and birders.

spots.bio: Northern Adelaide Hills park with marked walks such as the Mack Creek Hike, a campground and wildlife.
spots.name: Para Wirra Conservation Park
spots.note: Agency page names marked walks (Mack Creek Hike, Lake Discovery Walk), campground and wildlife.

spots.bio: Coastal wetlands north of Adelaide protecting shorebirds, with birdwatching sites along the coast.
spots.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Adelaide International Bird Sanctuary National Park
spots.name: Adelaide International Bird Sanctuary National Park

spots.bio: Samphire coast beach and birding spot on the Adelaide International Bird Sanctuary, with dolphin sightings.
spots.name: Thompson Beach
spots.note: NPWS SA (parks.sa.gov.au) names Thompson Beach among the top spots to birdwatch in the Adelaide International Bird Sanctuary (migratory shorebirds Oct-Apr); Wikivoyage lists it too.
